title: Last Stop
description:
In Last Stop you awaken alone in a train that’s hurtling through the subway, seemingly reliving the same moments over and over again. You’re not totally alone though – the train is also haunted by evil spirits, and apparently they“ like the dark”. It might be best for you to stay away from the shadows.

 .

The game Last Stop a psychological Horror in the first person.

Average time to complete the game: 60 minutes

IMPORTANT NOTE. The game was created by one person and Ue5 free and paid content where used to create this game.

 .
Great when played on the Steam Deck.
